title: Quiz — 8.5 & 8.6 Intercept Form and Comparing Functions

questions.prompt: What are the x-intercepts of $f(x) = (x - 3)(x + 4)$?

For $f(x) = -(x + 1)(x - 5)$, what is the maximum value?
Rewrite $f(x) = 3x^2 - 27$ in intercept form.
The zeros of a function are the same as its ___ -intercepts.
